name: Seek advice for interpersonal interactions and relationship building
description: Users sought advice on navigating various interpersonal dynamics, including how to initiate or maintain friendships, respond to social invitations, and handle awkward or sensitive conversations. Many requests specifically focused on strategies for expressing romantic feelings, interpreting a classmate's or friend's behavior, and communicating respectfully to avoid conflict or rejection.
